projects.name: Smart FAQ Chatbot — flagship polish
projects.description: Polish the existing .NET/Semantic Kernel/Ollama chatbot into a clear case study. The resume describes persistent sessions, conversational memory, SSE and operational protections; verify details against the repository before publishing.
features: Document actual multi-turn conversation and session behavior.
Show streaming contract, cancellation and provider failure behavior.
Explain validation, rate limits, resilience, logs and health checks.
Treat permission-aware RAG as planned until implemented.
requirements: README covers problem, architecture, setup, config, demo, tests and limitations.
Provide reproducible config without secrets and disclose model/hardware assumptions.
Add fixed evaluation cases before making quality claims.

frontend.approach: Use the existing React UI; prioritize the reviewer journey and clear source/error states.
frontend.done: A reviewer can run or view the chatbot, understand implemented behavior and reproduce the central workflow.

Quality checks against representative source text.

Report latency with model/runtime context.

projects.name: Accounting & Inventory Ledger API
projects.description: A .NET business backend that proves transactional and domain-rule depth. Build a small, auditable ledger and inventory workflow that reflects your professional ERP/accounting experience.
features: Chart of accounts, journal vouchers and balanced debit/credit posting.
Inventory receipt/issue or reservation with explicit stock invariants.
Immutable posting history, actor/time audit data and idempotent commands.
Optimistic concurrency and transaction-safe rollback.
Filtering, pagination, structured errors, health checks and API documentation.
requirements: The database and application enforce that posted entries balance; do not rely on UI validation.
Test duplicate posting, concurrent edits, rollback, unauthorized access and invalid transitions.
Include migrations, seed data, integration tests, Docker setup and a clear architecture decision record.
Measure one representative query and explain the chosen indexes and transaction boundary.

frontend.approach: Start with OpenAPI and a concise React review screen only if it helps demonstrate a complete business workflow.
screens: Chart of accounts and journal list
Voucher draft, validation and posting result
interactions: Reject an unbalanced or duplicate post
Show a concurrent edit conflict and audit trail
frontend.done: A reviewer can run the API, inspect its OpenAPI contract, reproduce a valid and invalid posting, and understand transactional guarantees.

milestones.title: Model ledger rules and API contracts
milestones.description: Define entities, constraints, states and invariants before coding endpoints.
tasks: Create schema, migration and OpenAPI request/response contracts.
milestones.deliverable: Domain note, schema and API contract

milestones.title: Implement safe posting and concurrency
milestones.description: Make posting atomic, idempotent and auditable.
tasks: Implement balanced posting inside an explicit transaction.
Add concurrency, duplicate and rollback integration cases.

milestones.title: Document and operate the service
milestones.description: Make the API reproducible and explain its performance and security.
tasks: Add authentication/authorization, validation, logs, health checks and CI.
Measure a query and write setup, runbook and ADR.

projects.name: Enterprise Document Intelligence (RAG)
projects.description: A focused .NET RAG system for approved business documents. Demonstrate ingestion, permission-aware retrieval, citations, evaluation and safe abstention before connecting it to business tools.
features: Versioned document ingestion with source metadata and visible processing failures.
Chunking and vector/keyword retrieval with metadata filters.
Answers grounded in allowed sources with inspectable citations.
Role/tenant-aware access enforced before and during retrieval.
Evaluation set for retrieval, groundedness, relevance and unanswerable questions.
requirements: Use synthetic or public sample documents; never upload confidential employer/client files.
Compare at least two retrieval configurations on the same fixed query set.
Test cross-tenant denial, prompt injection in retrieved documents and abstention when evidence is missing.
Report model/provider, dataset, evaluation method, latency assumptions, failures and limitations.

frontend.approach: A reviewer UI should show answer, source excerpts, ingestion state and explicit no-answer behavior.
interactions: Ingest and replace a sample document
Ask a supported and unsupported question
frontend.done: A reviewer can trace each answer to an authorized source and see measured retrieval/answer failures.

milestones.title: Build versioned ingestion and provenance
milestones.description: Preserve document identity, source spans and access metadata.
tasks: Parse sample files and record source/version metadata.
Handle duplicate upload, parse failure, replacement and deletion.

milestones.title: Establish retrieval baseline and citations
milestones.description: Compare retrieval choices against a fixed, labeled query set.
tasks: Return source citations and abstain on missing evidence.

milestones.title: Prove access boundaries and quality
milestones.description: Test permissions, prompt injection and answer regressions.
tasks: Add tenant/role denial and malicious-document test cases.
Publish quality slices, failure examples and limitations.

projects.name: Business Operations AI Assistant — senior capstone
projects.description: A focused permission-aware assistant for an ERP-style workflow. Start read-only: use authoritative APIs for business facts and let AI explain results with provenance.
features: Authenticated tenant-scoped read-only business tools.
Inventory, invoice or policy workflow grounded in approved sources.
Typed tool arguments, validated outputs and provenance.
Evaluation, audit trail, cost/latency and safe failure behavior.
Human review for consequential proposals.
requirements: No unrestricted SQL or direct model-controlled financial writes.
Tests prove access denial and tenant isolation.
Report evaluation, latency, cost assumptions and limitations.
Deploy or provide clean reproducible setup and runbook.

frontend.approach: A small reviewer workflow that makes authorization, provenance and human review visible.
frontend.done: A reviewer can explain data source, authorization, model role and failure path end to end.

projects.name: Senior Engineering Ownership Casebook
projects.description: Turn real work and portfolio decisions into evidence of senior judgment. This is not a substitute for experience you did not have.
features: Architecture and migration decisions.
Delivery plans, risks and trade-offs.
Failure review and operational follow-up.
Peer review, mentoring or knowledge sharing.
Interview stories tied to artifacts and attributable outcomes.
requirements: Use attributable examples and sanitize confidential details.
Separate your ownership from team outcomes.
State constraints, alternatives, evidence and limits.

frontend.approach: A private notes folder or sanitized portfolio page; no application UI is required.
frontend.done: Each senior claim has an artifact, accurate ownership boundary and clear result.
